name: rocksndiamonds
author: rsn8887
description: Rocks'n'Diamonds is a scrolling tile-based computer puzzle game that can be described as a combined Boulder Dash, Supaplex, Emerald Mine, and Sokoban clone. It is a free software game under the GPLv2 license created by Artsoft Entertainment and designed by Holger Schemel. For additional level packs, see the release notes at https://github.com/rsn8887/rocksndiamonds/releases/latest
